description: This file defines a React component for visualizing a film strip or timeline of screencast frames, including rendering frames, handling hover previews, and layout management within a trace viewer application.

methods.name: FilmStrip
methods.description: Main React component that renders the film strip UI with lanes and hover preview.

methods.name: FilmStripLane
methods.description: Subcomponent rendering individual lane of screencast frames based on page data.

methods.name: timeComparator
methods.description: Helper function to compare a time value with a frame's timestamp.

methods.name: inscribe
methods.description: Utility function to scale sizes to fit within a designated area.
